body: rgb(18, 16, 35) none repeat scroll 0% 0% / auto padding-box border-box
header: rgb(21, 17, 39) none repeat scroll 0% 0% / auto padding-box border-box
styles: .head { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 100%; z-index: 15; }
* { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; }
body.stremio-hybrid .head { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035); background: var(--sh-header) !important; }
